verdict.rationale: Baseten ships official CLIs. The Truss CLI (`uvx truss push`) and `baseten model push` deploy models, a single CLI command deploys training checkpoints, and a documented Baseten Switch CLI reference routes Claude Code or Codex CLI to Model APIs. An agent skill also lets coding agents manage the workspace. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI experience, and evidence of the full CLI command surface beyond push/deploy/routing.
